diagnosis: The best code has an enormous near-exact active set, with roughly 475 pairs tied at the maximum to machine precision, but that load is highly uneven: points 0–56 have about 20–39 contacts while points 57–77 mostly have under 19 and one is a rattler. Its top-principal-component projection separates into two strata near PC1 \(=-0.2\) and \(+0.4\), so the configuration is an anisotropic, jammed core plus comparatively loose satellites rather than an isotropic tight configuration. Trust-region LP polishing and single-point or rattler perturbations therefore return to the same basin: moving a core point violates many tied pairs, while moving a loose point does not relieve the core. The missing structural property is balanced tightness—comparable personal maxima, contact degrees and dual stress across all 78 points, together with near-isotropic covariance. Recent global rebuilds also timed out before producing a polished alternative, so the next attempts need strict internal deadlines well below 180 seconds.
